== Summary ==
Slip “•Cloud City: Lower Corridor (LIGHT)” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (71, 1535, 757, 2083)). Version [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
